research_question: Can a 5-input recurrent weight-writing circuit invent fourth-order causal features when the previous WSP-03 degree-three gate language failed, retain multiple newly compiled features, and correctly refuse a fifth-order explanation when evidence is insufficient?

world.lower_degree_basis: all integer mask values 0..31 with popcount<=3, sorted ascending (26 contexts)
world.coefficients: SHA256 UTF8 string 'WSP04|seed={seed}|action={action}|mask={mask}' first digest byte &1. Base reward XORs all coefficients for basis monomials mask subset context.
world.novel: Only action=1 has fourth-order monomials: mode0 none, mode1 first pair mask, mode2 first and second pair masks. Each active monomial toggles binary reward iff its mask subset context.
world.negative: After scoring, fifth-order negative flips action1 reward only when context=31, independently for every 120-world configuration.
world.adversarial_info_limit: At context31, only two of five possible fourth-order coefficients are observed. No learner can identify a fifth-order cause uniquely without additional lower-order evidence. Do not claim identified fifth-order structure.

evaluation.order: seed 0..7; pairs as listed; novelty mode 0,1,2; 120 public worlds. For each: observe 26 lower-degree contexts x action0 then action1 (52 outcomes); score context31 before witnesses; observe first pair mask/action1; score; observe second pair mask/action1; score; cold checkpoint; replay four already seen outcomes; score independent fifth-order perturbation before witness; observe one actual context31/action1 fifth-order negative; verify fail-closed.
evaluation.holdout: No reward at context31 before test; no held-out label fed to fit control.
evaluation.correct_scoring: Exact action decision including abstain only when true reward tie. Also separately score reward-0 and reward-1, decisive vs ties, confidence errors.
controls: Independent exact symbolic ANF inversion on identical experiences, with sparse-default extrapolation; must tie direct-weight circuit if correct
Degree-3 no-growth circuit with identical experience; must refuse nonzero observed degree-four effect
Experience-erased direct-weight circuit, must abstain with insufficient basis
Fixed-budget conventional 6-12-1 tanh/sigmoid MLP, 97 floating parameters, seed17, learning rate .05, 256 full-batch epochs, trained only on 54 public (context,action,outcome) examples per world
measurements: new fourth-order binary threshold cells and recurrent state
fifth-order negative pre-witness wrong confidently decisive cases and fail-closed after genuine contradicting witness
trained MLP final loss, correctness, wall-clock time and circuit memory

acceptance.mechanism_pass: If and only if exact symbolic/control and direct circuit agree for all 120 final decisions and both reward predictions, all final decisions match the frozen synthetic world, all 120 cold restores/replays are exact, a fourth-order threshold gate is genuinely added on public residual, and fifth-order witness yields conservative abstention without over-claimed recovery.
acceptance.negative: Preserve both initial and intermediate confident errors, especially degree5 false confidence. A tie with symbolic gives NO scientific advantage.
acceptance.science: Public synthetic development only. No independently sourced novel world, strong fully converged trained comparator, parity-matched whole-process compute, or first-use. SCIENTIFIC_UNVERIFIED even on 120/120.
acceptance.invalid: Changing world generator, masks, seeds, observation order, holdout, witness, model capacity, controls, thresholds or metric definitions after primary outcomes. Implementation bug repairs must be documented and rerun full final qualification.
acceptance.scope: Isolated research/contrib/chatgpt/WSP-04 plus generated fail-closed G29 atlas and read-only PR CI companions; no existing model/controller/runner/schedule/acceptance changes.
